judge_verdict.summary: The agent misread panel D and answered 3 instead of the correct count of 2 steps where R414Q exceeds the mutant.

verdict.outcome_rationale: This is a genuine agent-fault failure—the verifier's INCORRECT verdict is correct [1]. The task asked, in panel D, how many voltage steps had a greater response in ASAP2f R414Q than in ASAP2f L146G S147T R414Q, with the shuffled MCQ resolved against baked-in ground truth text "2" [2][3]. After running setup.py to generate instruction.md and the letter mapping, the agent read figure.jpg and submitted [ANSWER]B[/ANSWER], which mapped to "3" rather than "2" (letter A) under its shuffle [4][5]. Its reasoning counted all three upward (positive) deflections as steps where the black R414Q trace exceeded the purple mutant trace, explicitly treating pulse 3 as black ~8% versus purple ~6% and concluding the total was 3 [6][7]. Independent inspection of panel D shows only the first two positive pulses clearly have a higher black response (~+40 vs ~+32 and ~+23 vs ~+20); the third positive pulse is nearly overlapping at ~+8 for both traces, and the subsequent negative pulses are also essentially coincident, yielding exactly two qualifying steps [8]. The agent therefore did not accomplish the figure-reading task despite a thorough attempt and correct output formatting, so the run is TN: verifier fail and genuinely not solved [1][5][8].
